module_snapshot.image_prompt: Produce one independent photographic image for the cup_detail module only; do not generate a collage, grid, or any other module. Edit the existing second-module visual while preserving the red unbranded ceramic cup's visible shape, rim, handle, proportions, and surface appearance from the supplied reference asset. Use a close three-quarter detail view with the cup body filling about 70% of the frame, rim positioned upper-left, handle extending to the right, and the focal plane at the rim edge and handle connection. Replace the background with a bright matte warm ivory-beige tabletop and a softly matching neutral backdrop. Use a controlled soft key light from upper-left/front to reveal the rim edge, inner opening, handle curve, and connection detail; add gentle frontal fill to preserve red tonal gradation, with a restrained highlight and natural soft contact shadow on the tabletop. Keep realistic perspective, scale, occlusion, depth of field, and physical grounding. Preserve clean negative space on the right for separately typeset native English copy. Do not add logos, patterns, text inside the image, props, performance claims, invented material texture, or unseen structural details.
